objective: Define the SM89 hardware capability contract used by all Ada-specific tuning paths.
mathematical_spec: Let C be the runtime capability vector C=(cc_major,cc_minor,warp_size,max_threads_sm,max_threads_block,regs_sm,smem_sm,l2_bytes,async_engines,tensor_core_modes). Enable Ada tuning iff (cc_major,cc_minor)=(8,9); every downstream choice is a function f(C) with a portable fallback.
implementation_prompt: Add a read-only runtime capability descriptor for compute capability 8.9. Query CUDA device attributes once, normalize them into a compact struct, expose feature predicates for SM89-only policies, and keep fallback behavior explicit. Do not hardcode board-specific memory sizes.

objective: Specify SM89 thread-block geometry candidates for latency-sensitive decode kernels.
mathematical_spec: For block size B in {64,128,256,512}, define active warps W_a(B)=min(W_hw, floor(T_sm/B)*B/32) subject to register and shared-memory limits. Candidate geometry maximizes useful_warps/issued_warps under measured kernel latency.
implementation_prompt: Create a launch-geometry policy that enumerates power-of-two block sizes valid on SM89 and returns candidates with their theoretical occupancy constraints. Keep the policy independent of any one kernel so later modules can benchmark candidates.

objective: Model warp scheduling pressure for tree-draft kernels on Ada.
mathematical_spec: For a kernel with instruction classes i, define issue pressure P=sum_i n_i/throughput_i and latency cover L=ceil(max_i latency_i/independent_issue_slots). Require resident_warps >= L when resource limits permit.
implementation_prompt: Define a lightweight scheduling model for SM89 that records instruction mix assumptions and estimates the resident warp count needed to hide latency. Use it as metadata for tuning, not as a replacement for measurement.

objective: Compute theoretical occupancy from registers, shared memory, warps, and block limits.
mathematical_spec: For block B, registers/thread R, shared bytes/block S: blocks_sm=min(block_limit, floor(T_sm/B), floor(Reg_sm/(R*B)), floor(Smem_sm/S)); occupancy=(blocks_sm*B)/(max_threads_sm).
implementation_prompt: Implement a pure occupancy calculator for SM89 launch candidates. Inputs are block size, registers per thread, static plus dynamic shared memory, and device limits; outputs include limiting resource and resident blocks/warps.

objective: Define register-pressure guardrails for decode and gather kernels.
mathematical_spec: Let R be registers/thread and B threads/block. Reject a candidate if floor(Reg_sm/(R*B))=0; mark pressure cliffs where resident_blocks decreases after a one-register allocation granularity step.
implementation_prompt: Add register-pressure analysis that detects occupancy cliffs caused by compiler register allocation. Report thresholds per block geometry so kernel authors can choose launch bounds or reduce live ranges with evidence.

objective: Specify shared-memory carveout policy for kernels that trade L1 capacity for staging space.
mathematical_spec: Let S_req be required shared bytes/block and S_max(c) the limit under carveout c. Choose the smallest carveout c satisfying S_req<=S_max(c), then benchmark neighboring valid carveouts because effective L1 capacity changes.
implementation_prompt: Define an SM89 shared-memory carveout policy driven by requested dynamic shared memory. Expose candidate carveouts and the implied L1/shared tradeoff without forcing a global device setting.

objective: Budget dynamic shared memory for reusable tree-draft staging buffers.
mathematical_spec: For staging components s_j with size a_j and alignment q_j, S_dyn=align_sum({a_j}, {q_j}); validity requires S_static+S_dyn<=S_limit(selected_carveout).
implementation_prompt: Create a deterministic shared-memory layout calculator for logits tiles, token IDs, prefix metadata, and reduction scratch. Return offsets, aligned total bytes, and overflow diagnostics.

objective: Define global-memory alignment contracts for vectorized loads and stores.
mathematical_spec: For vector width V bytes, a transaction is vector-safe iff address mod V=0 and stride mod V=0. Select the largest V in {16,8,4} satisfying alignment and element-count divisibility, else scalar.
implementation_prompt: Specify reusable pointer/stride alignment checks and a vector-width selector for SM89 memory kernels. The fast path must require proven alignment; misaligned tails must remain correct.

objective: Specify coalesced global-memory access rules for warp-level token and KV traffic.
mathematical_spec: For lane l accessing address A_l, minimize the number of 32-byte sectors touched by {A_l}. Define coalescing efficiency E=useful_bytes/(32*sectors_touched).
implementation_prompt: Define layout and indexing guidance that maps adjacent lanes to adjacent token/KV elements. Add a measurable coalescing-efficiency metric that later benchmarks can compute from requested bytes and sectors.

objective: Specify asynchronous global-to-shared staging on SM89.
mathematical_spec: For pipeline depth d, tile transfer time T_m and compute time T_c, steady-state tile time approximates max(T_m,T_c) when d>=2 and dependencies are correctly staged; otherwise T_tile=T_m+T_c.
implementation_prompt: Design a cp.async-style staged copy policy for eligible CUDA kernels on SM89, including tile size, double-buffering, commit/wait boundaries, alignment requirements, and a synchronous fallback.

objective: Model L2 working-set residency for decode-time hot data.
mathematical_spec: For hot working set H and effective L2 budget L_eff, target residency ratio rho=min(1,L_eff/H). Define expected miss traffic M=(1-rho)*bytes_reused per reuse epoch.
implementation_prompt: Add a simple L2 working-set model for model metadata, KV pages, tree topology, and verifier gather tables. Use runtime L2 size and measured hot-set bytes; do not assume all boards share one cache size.

objective: Specify CUDA L2 access-policy-window candidates for persistent hot regions.
mathematical_spec: For hot region size H, hit ratio target h, and persisting budget P, require reserved_bytes<=P and window_bytes<=device_window_limit. Candidate benefit is measured delta in L2 hit rate and kernel latency.
implementation_prompt: Define optional stream access-policy-window configuration for hot read-mostly regions when supported. Include eligibility checks, reset behavior, and a benchmark gate so the policy can be disabled when it harms competing traffic.

objective: Lay out paged KV cache metadata to improve L2 locality during speculative verification.
mathematical_spec: For page size p tokens and ordered access sequence q_k, define locality cost C=sum_k distance_bytes(meta(q_k),meta(q_{k+1})). Minimize C while preserving O(1) page lookup and stable page IDs.
implementation_prompt: Specify a compact, cache-line-aware layout for KV page descriptors used by tree verification. Keep hot fields contiguous, move cold bookkeeping out of the primary traversal path, and preserve stable indexing.

objective: Lay out tree-node metadata for warp-coherent traversal.
mathematical_spec: For node record size r and warp batch of 32 adjacent logical nodes, target ceil(32*r/128) cache lines with structure-of-arrays for fields consumed independently. Minimize bytes fetched per traversal step.
implementation_prompt: Define an SM89-friendly tree metadata layout covering parent index, depth, token, score, and flags. Separate hot traversal fields from cold diagnostics and document alignment/packing invariants.

objective: Specify verifier gather ordering that converts irregular accepted-node reads into locality-friendly batches.
mathematical_spec: Given requested indices I={i_k}, define a stable permutation pi minimizing page transitions sum_k [page(i_pi(k)) != page(i_pi(k+1))] while retaining an inverse permutation for output order.
implementation_prompt: Design a gather-planning step that groups verifier reads by KV page or contiguous span, emits the inverse mapping, and limits planning overhead for small trees. Keep semantics stable relative to original node order.

objective: Define tensor-core datatype policy for Ada verification and projection GEMMs.
mathematical_spec: For candidate dtype d in {FP16,BF16,TF32,FP8_if_supported}, choose only if numerical_error(d)<=epsilon and shape/support constraints hold. Performance score is effective_TFLOPS(d)/conversion_overhead(d).
implementation_prompt: Create a runtime tensor-core mode policy for SM89. Gate modes by CUDA/library support and an externally supplied numerical-tolerance decision; expose supported candidates without silently changing model precision.

objective: Specify tensor-core-friendly matrix shape padding and alignment.
mathematical_spec: For GEMM (M,N,K), padded dimensions M',N',K' are the least supported tile multiples >= original dimensions. Padding overhead O=(M'N'K'-MNK)/(MNK); use padding only when O<=configured threshold.
implementation_prompt: Define shape-normalization rules for small speculative batches so tensor-core kernels receive aligned dimensions. Preserve exact logical extents and mask padded outputs.

objective: Specify cuBLASLt algorithm selection for small-batch speculative GEMMs on SM89.
mathematical_spec: For algorithm a, score S_a=median_latency_a with workspace W_a<=W_budget and correctness error<=epsilon. Cache argmin_a S_a by shape, dtype, epilogue, and device UUID.
implementation_prompt: Design a cuBLASLt heuristic and benchmark cache for the small M regimes produced by speculative decoding. Include workspace limits, deterministic keying, warmup, and fallback when no tuned result exists.

objective: Specify FP8 tensor-core eligibility for Ada when the runtime stack exposes supported FP8 modes.
mathematical_spec: For scaled tensor x with scale s, quantization error e=||x-dequant(q(x,s),s)||/||x||. FP8 is eligible only if e<=epsilon, library support is present, and required scale metadata is available.
implementation_prompt: Define an optional FP8 capability path for SM89 without assuming universal CUDA or model support. Specify scale metadata, conversion boundaries, correctness gating, and fallback to FP16/BF16.

objective: Specify fused dequantization-to-tensor-core staging for quantized weights.
mathematical_spec: For quantized tile Q and scale z, fused cost T_fuse=T_load(Q)+T_dequant_shared+T_mma; compare against T_sep=T_dequant_global+T_reload+T_mma. Enable only when measured T_fuse<T_sep.
implementation_prompt: Design the interface and staging contract for a kernel that dequantizes weight tiles into tensor-core-ready fragments without writing an intermediate global tensor. Define supported quant formats separately from the scheduling policy.

objective: Define CUDA stream roles for speculative decode overlap.
mathematical_spec: Represent work as DAG G=(V,E) over streams S={compute_main,compute_aux,h2d,d2h}. Assign nodes to streams so dependencies are preserved and independent copy/compute nodes may overlap.
implementation_prompt: Specify a small fixed stream topology for draft, verify, H2D metadata, and D2H result traffic. Document ownership, lifetime, and which operations may overlap; avoid unbounded stream creation.

objective: Define event-based cross-stream dependency rules without host synchronization.
mathematical_spec: For edge u->v crossing streams, record event e_u after u and enqueue wait(e_u) before v. Correctness requires every cross-stream happens-before edge be represented exactly once or by a transitive predecessor.
implementation_prompt: Create an event dependency model for the stream DAG. Use reusable CUDA events, disable timing for dependency-only events, and forbid host-side device synchronization in steady-state decode.

objective: Specify CUDA stream priority use for latency-critical verifier work.
mathematical_spec: Let latency-critical set C and background set B share device capacity. Assign higher priority only when measured p99(C) improves without reducing throughput(B) beyond configured budget beta.
implementation_prompt: Define optional stream-priority candidates for verifier kernels and low-priority maintenance/copy work. Query supported priority range at runtime and treat priority as a tuning parameter, not a correctness requirement.

objective: Model copy/compute overlap efficiency.
mathematical_spec: Given copy interval C and compute interval K, overlap efficiency E_o=(|C|+|K|-makespan(C union K))/min(|C|,|K|). Target E_o near 1 for independent work.
implementation_prompt: Add a timeline-level overlap metric and scheduling rules for metadata transfers versus GPU compute. Identify false dependencies that serialize streams and expose them in telemetry.

objective: Define pinned-host-memory allocation policy for latency-sensitive transfers.
mathematical_spec: For transfer size n and reuse count r, pinned memory is eligible when amortized pin_cost/r + T_dma_pinned(n) < T_pageable(n). Enforce a bounded pinned-byte budget.
implementation_prompt: Specify pinned host allocations for frequently transferred token IDs, tree metadata, and small result buffers. Include a hard budget, graceful pageable fallback, and explicit ownership/lifetime.

objective: Design a reusable pinned-memory pool to avoid per-step pin/unpin overhead.
mathematical_spec: Partition pool into size classes c_i. For request n, choose min c_i>=n. Fragmentation F=1-sum(requested_live_bytes)/sum(class_bytes_live); maintain bounded F and total pinned bytes.
implementation_prompt: Define a thread-safe pinned-buffer pool with size classes, reuse, upper bounds, and telemetry. Avoid cudaHostAlloc/cudaFreeHost on the steady-state decode path.

objective: Specify mapped pinned-memory eligibility for tiny host-produced control data.
mathematical_spec: For payload n, zero-copy mapped access wins only if T_gpu_read_mapped(n,access_pattern) < T_H2D(n)+T_gpu_read_device(n). Restrict to read-mostly tiny control buffers.
implementation_prompt: Define an optional mapped-host-memory path for tiny control structures. Gate it by device support, access pattern, and benchmark evidence; never use it for bulk KV or logits traffic.

objective: Tune PCIe DMA transfer chunk sizes for host-device metadata traffic.
mathematical_spec: For payload N split into chunks c, T(N,c)=ceil(N/c)*L_dma + N/B_eff(c). Candidate c minimizes T while permitting useful overlap with compute.
implementation_prompt: Create a transfer chunking policy for H2D/D2H buffers. Benchmark a small geometric set of chunk sizes, respect alignment, and cache the best size by direction and size range.

objective: Batch small asynchronous DMA requests to reduce launch and bus transaction overhead.
mathematical_spec: For requests n_i arriving in window tau, batch if sum_i L_dma > L_batch + copy_pack + copy_unpack and added queue delay<=latency_budget.
implementation_prompt: Define a bounded micro-batching layer for small control transfers. Preserve request boundaries through offset metadata and cap batching delay so token latency remains predictable.

objective: Specify bidirectional PCIe scheduling for simultaneous H2D metadata and D2H results.
mathematical_spec: Let B_h2d and B_d2h be measured directional bandwidth under concurrency. Schedule overlap only if concurrent makespan max(Nh/B_h2d,Nd/B_d2h) beats serialized transfer time.
implementation_prompt: Add a duplex-transfer policy that benchmarks concurrent versus serialized H2D/D2H on the current system and selects the lower-latency mode per traffic class.

objective: Define the device allocator interface used by speculative decode temporary buffers.
mathematical_spec: Allocator operations are alloc(size,align,stream), free(ptr,stream), reserve(bytes), trim(); invariants: returned address mod align=0, stream lifetime is respected, and allocation failure is explicit.
implementation_prompt: Specify a narrow allocator abstraction for GPU scratch and persistent buffers. Keep allocation semantics compatible with synchronous fallback and stream-ordered implementations.

objective: Specify stream-ordered cudaMallocAsync/cudaFreeAsync usage.
mathematical_spec: For allocation A on stream s, lifetime is [alloc_event,free_event] in stream order; any cross-stream use must be preceded by dependency edges establishing alloc before use and use before free.
implementation_prompt: Design a cudaMallocAsync-backed allocator path with runtime support checks. Encode cross-stream lifetime rules and provide a conventional cudaMalloc fallback.

objective: Tune CUDA memory-pool reservation and release thresholds.
mathematical_spec: Let peak steady-state live bytes P and reserve factor alpha>=1. Set retained target R=alpha*P under global memory budget; trim when reserved-live exceeds hysteresis threshold H for configured epochs.
implementation_prompt: Define mempool attributes and adaptive retention policy for speculative workloads. Avoid aggressive trimming between tokens and expose reserved, used, and high-water bytes.

objective: Design a per-step scratch arena for short-lived decode temporaries.
mathematical_spec: For buffers b_i with lifetimes [s_i,e_i), arena size A is the maximum weighted interval overlap after alignment; offsets may be reused when lifetimes do not overlap.
implementation_prompt: Specify a linear/lifetime-aware scratch arena for token-step temporaries. Build the layout from known operation lifetimes, return aligned offsets, and reset by epoch instead of freeing individual buffers.

objective: Design slab allocation for fixed-size tree nodes and descriptors.
mathematical_spec: For object size o, alignment a, slab size S, capacity=floor(S/align(o,a)). Internal waste per slab is S-capacity*align(o,a); choose S to bound waste and metadata overhead.
implementation_prompt: Define a fixed-size slab allocator for frequently created tree-node GPU descriptors. Keep allocation O(1), avoid pointer chasing in device-visible metadata, and support bulk reset per request.

objective: Centralize alignment requirements across host buffers, device buffers, and tensor tiles.
mathematical_spec: For object x, required alignment A_x=lcm(A_vector,A_dma,A_tensor,A_allocator) over applicable constraints. Valid offset o satisfies o mod A_x=0.
implementation_prompt: Create one alignment contract table for each buffer class used by tree-draft decode. Derive offsets and allocation requests from it so vectorized kernels, DMA, and tensor-core staging agree.

objective: Specify stride and pitch rules for batched tree tensors.
mathematical_spec: For logical tensor dimensions d_k and element size e, choose physical strides s_k aligned to required byte boundary A where s_k*e mod A=0 for vectorized dimensions; logical indexing remains unchanged.
implementation_prompt: Define padded physical strides for token, score, parent, and small-batch activation tensors. Expose logical extents separately so padding never changes semantics.

objective: Measure allocator fragmentation and allocation-path latency.
mathematical_spec: Define external fragmentation F_ext=1-largest_free_block/free_bytes when observable, internal fragmentation F_int=(reserved-requested)/reserved, and record p50/p95/p99 alloc/free latency.
implementation_prompt: Add allocator telemetry covering live, reserved, peak, internal fragmentation, optional external fragmentation, allocation failures, and latency histograms by allocator path.

objective: Define CUDA Graph capture eligibility for the speculative decode DAG.
mathematical_spec: A step is capturable iff operation topology, stream dependencies, kernel function identities, and allocation behavior satisfy CUDA capture constraints; dynamic scalar/pointer values must be updateable without topology mutation.
implementation_prompt: Create a capture-eligibility checker for the decode execution plan. Report the first unsupported operation or dynamic topology reason instead of attempting capture blindly.

objective: Specify a static CUDA Graph capture path for repeated decode shapes.
mathematical_spec: For shape key k=(batch,tree_nodes,kv_bucket,dtype), capture graph G_k after warmup. Replay is valid while topology-equivalent inputs stay within captured resource bounds.
implementation_prompt: Design per-shape CUDA Graph capture and replay for the steady decode path. Use a bounded graph cache keyed by stable execution-shape attributes and preserve a normal stream path as fallback.

objective: Specify graph parameter updates for changing pointers, scalars, and kernel dimensions.
mathematical_spec: Given captured graph G and update set U, replay is allowed when CUDA graph update reports topology compatibility and every changed node parameter satisfies the node's update constraints.
implementation_prompt: Define safe per-replay updates for kernel arguments, memcpy endpoints, and sizes. On incompatible update, invalidate or recapture the keyed graph instead of reusing stale parameters.

objective: Model CUDA Graph cache capacity and eviction.
mathematical_spec: For graph entry i with memory cost m_i and reuse frequency f_i, maintain sum m_i<=M_budget. Evict using recency weighted by capture_cost and reuse frequency to avoid thrashing.
implementation_prompt: Define a bounded graph-exec cache with hit/miss/capture counters, memory accounting, and deterministic eviction. Include explicit destruction outside active replay.

objective: Autotune occupancy-sensitive launch parameters using measured latency.
mathematical_spec: For candidate set C from geometry and resource models, measure robust latency L_c=median(samples after warmup); select argmin_c L_c subject to correctness and occupancy floor O_min when configured.
implementation_prompt: Build an autotuning specification for block size, shared-memory tile size, and limited unroll variants. Persist results by device UUID, driver/runtime version, kernel identity, and shape bucket.

objective: Specify launch-bounds decisions using measured register and occupancy tradeoffs.
mathematical_spec: For candidate minBlocksPerSM b, compile/runtime variant is useful only if latency L_b improves and spills S_b do not exceed spill budget. Prefer the least restrictive bound among statistically equivalent candidates.
implementation_prompt: Define how launch-bounds variants are compared for hot kernels. Capture registers, local-memory spills, theoretical occupancy, and measured latency so a bound is never chosen from occupancy alone.

objective: Discover NUMA topology relevant to the GPU's PCIe attachment.
mathematical_spec: Define NUMA distance D(cpu_node,gpu_root) from OS topology when available. Preferred host node n*=argmin_n D(n,gpu_root), with unknown topology yielding no affinity action.
implementation_prompt: Specify host NUMA discovery that maps the CUDA device PCI bus ID to its nearest CPU/NUMA node on supported systems. Keep the feature optional and no-op when topology cannot be resolved.

objective: Define host-thread affinity for submission and transfer threads.
mathematical_spec: For thread class t, choose CPU set C_t on preferred NUMA node while avoiding oversubscription. Evaluate jitter J=p99_submit_latency-p50_submit_latency and move affinity only when J or transfer latency improves.
implementation_prompt: Define affinity policy for CUDA submission, pinned-memory preparation, and background telemetry threads. Preserve user-provided affinity settings and make automatic pinning opt-in/tunable.

objective: Align pinned-host allocation locality with the GPU's PCIe/NUMA topology.
mathematical_spec: For pinned buffer b used by GPU g, placement penalty P_b=latency(node(b),root(g))*bytes(b). Prefer allocating/touching reusable buffers on the nearest eligible NUMA node.
implementation_prompt: Specify first-touch/allocation placement for pinned pools near the selected GPU. Document behavior for multi-GPU or unresolved topology and measure H2D/D2H latency before enabling.

objective: Define GPU hardware telemetry needed to validate Ada tuning.
mathematical_spec: Collect per-epoch metrics M={kernel_duration,sm_active,dram_bytes,l2_hit_rate,pcie_tx,pcie_rx,graph_replays,stream_waits} when available, tagged by device and workload shape. Sampling overhead must remain below budget delta.
implementation_prompt: Define a low-overhead telemetry interface with optional CUPTI/NVML-backed providers and a no-op provider. Separate always-on counters from profiling-only metrics and timestamp them on a monotonic clock.

objective: Define memory-system telemetry and bottleneck classification.
mathematical_spec: Compute achieved bandwidth B=bytes/time, L2 reuse R=hits/(hits+misses), overlap E_o from timelines, and classify a sample using measured ceilings instead of fixed board specs. Confidence requires sufficient samples.
implementation_prompt: Create derived metrics for device memory bandwidth, L2 effectiveness, allocator pressure, PCIe throughput, and copy/compute overlap. Emit raw inputs alongside classifications so tuning decisions are auditable.

objective: Define the SM89 tuning acceptance matrix and regression thresholds.
mathematical_spec: For each workload bucket w and policy p, speedup S=T_baseline/T_p, memory delta D=M_p-M_baseline, and error E. Accept p when S>=1+sigma, D<=budget_w, E<=epsilon_w, and p99 latency regression stays within budget.
implementation_prompt: Specify a benchmark/telemetry acceptance matrix for Ada tuning decisions across tree sizes, context buckets, and transfer regimes. Record baseline, tuned metrics, confidence bounds, and automatic fallback criteria; this module closes Pilar E without implementing kernels.
